Submit application via Please apply via uni-assist.
Prospective students from non-EU countries submit their application to uni-assist (see application deadline).

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states "Tuition fees per semester None" for the programme; the university-wide page confirms no tuition fees, but all students pay a semester contribution (about 350 EUR per semester on the DAAD page, about 320 EUR on the UDE programme page). Intakes: the application period 1 May - 15 June on the DAAD page is for the winter semester; no year is stated, so the year is left out. The 'documents' fact is included based on the general enrolment page (NON-EU applicants), which names 'University entrance certificate'; the programme page does not list required documents. Language rules are drawn from the DAAD page for this programme; the UDE programme pages state B1 for both languages at enrollment with B2 as a graduation requirement, so cross-check the exact level.

evidence.quote: the applicant has taken mathematics in the last 3 years of the previous education, entitling him/her to direct university admission and has achieved a grade of 2.5 or better.
